topLevel.why: Both trees preserve all seven main chapter boundaries, but Y also gives the explicitly headed Bibliography its own part. Its inclusion of the short acknowledgements in Historic Perspective is a smaller mismatch than X's merging acknowledgements with the bibliography.

gists.why: Most paired gists are substantively equivalent, but X offers more targeted guidance for passages 3 and 4 through its descriptions of isometries and structure groups. Y's broader manifold and gauge summaries are accurate but less specific to those passages.

weldedParts.why: Combines the separately headed acknowledgements and bibliography, rather than preserving the bibliography as a distinct reference division.
Includes the acknowledgements after the historical discussion ends, joining historical exposition with administrative thanks.

overall.why: The main chapter map is essentially identical, while X's more focused section gists make it easier to locate the relevant mathematical discussion. That advantage outweighs its minor back-matter grouping weakness.
